event_rule: Take, in public release-time order, the first 12 non-draft non-prerelease releases after the three cutoffs, with no repository contributing more than 6 events. If fewer than 12 exist at study close, analyze every eligible event without lowering eligibility.
forbidden_pre_outcome_information: native validation result for the new release
success_gate: zero false promotions by the reusable sealed policy on decidable events, strictly fewer revalidations than always-revalidate on at least one nontrivial stratum, and no post-hoc alpha/budget reset
stop_rule: A false promotion, custody failure, event-order ambiguity, or insufficient machine-authoritative gold closes the lane without rescue under this identity.
authority_ceiling: external-objective temporal evidence; not external-investigator authority
